<b>Mnemonids</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are flying creatures able to reform after being destroyed, because the coldshard they are formed from remembers its former shape.<ref>Mnemonid [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Flighted creature formed from coldshard. If shattered it will quickly reform. The coldshard, even when destroyed it remembers its former shape."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Mnemonids float in place, dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact. If [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, they blink for a brief moment before exploding in a circle of lingering spikes. After a few seconds, they reform in the same location. Mnemonids cannot be destroyed with regular attacks, but count as defeated once they explode. 

They are used primarily for traversal via [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bouncing]] or the [[Clawline]].

==Trivia==
*The 1.0.27535 and 1.0.27776 versions of <i>Silksong</i> playable on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch respectively, which are older than the PC launch version (1.0.28324), have the word "iceshard" instead of "coldshard" in the journal description.<ref>[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GaNLkTTszFKFv55DZj3Iw1hTUi6gbstSR56WXizrMAI Silksong Switch full text] on Google Docs</ref>
* The Mnemonid's name is derived from the term "mnemonic", which refers to things related to memory.
